item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: I've had my ups and downs, my fair share of bumpy roads and heavy winds. thats what made me what I am today.`Van damme` I had the wake up call a month ago. I needed to wake up and focus on my what am I doing building my career. I began cutting all extra dopamine sources. First, errotic materials. Second, Doom-Scrolling. task one is done; that's why i finally found the time to make a blog and start creating rather than consuming.
